messages.name: Vandelay Industries admin
messages.body: Receipt scanning doesn't read our handwritten taxi receipts at all.

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: Handwritten receipts are a known limitation, BUG-2100-01 (Low, Won't Fix): OCR accuracy on handwriting is below 40%. Typed and printed receipts scan reliably. Please type the amount for handwritten ones.
